source.title: AI use leads UC Berkeley math professor to see 'no point' in grading homework
source.author: romanhn

title.zh: AI让伯克利数学教授放弃作业评分
title.en: AI Forcing UC Berkeley Math Professor to Abandon Homework Grading

excerpt.zh: UC Berkeley数学教授Richard Borcherds不再给学生作业评分，因为AI已不可避免地完成所有作业。他认为即使AI持续改进，未来几年人类数学家将毫无用武之地。学术系统惯性明显，政策仍由教师自主决定。
excerpt.en: UC Berkeley math professor Richard Borcherds now skips grading homework, as AI already does the work. He sees no point in traditional assessment and worries human mathematicians may soon be obsolete. Campus AI policies

text.zh: AI让伯克利数学教授放弃作业评分
text.en: UC Berkeley Math Professor Drops Homework Grading

text.zh: UC Berkeley数学教授Richard Borcherds不再给学生作业评分，因为AI已不可避免地完成所有作业。他认为即使AI持续改进，未来几年人类数学家将毫无用武之地。
text.en: UC Berkeley math professor Richard Borcherds no longer grades homework assignments. He believes AI now completes them entirely, rendering traditional assessment pointless as improvements continue.

text.zh: Borcherds透露，在OpenAI宣布AI代理解决Navier-Stokes存在性和光滑性问题后，他选择此举。他承认当前仅以完成度计分是“不可接受的系统”，但别无他法。
text.en: Borcherds revealed this after OpenAI’s announcement that AI agents solved the Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem. He said grading solely on completion is “not a very good system” but offered no alternative.

text.zh: 他还表示无法建议学生是否继续攻读数学，因为五年前AI热潮曾让数学成为最安全职业之一。如今他已向ChatGPT求教相同问题，回答同样不知所措。
text.en: He added he has no idea what advice to give students on pursuing mathematics, as it once seemed safest career amid the AI boom. He even asked ChatGPT the same question, receiving no clear answer.

text.zh: 伯克利学术参议院要求教师在课纲中声明AI工具使用政策，但具体规则因课程而异。校方已试用Turnitin和Rumi检测工具，但未标准化；教师可根据课程自行决定，学校AI Hub提供样例语句供参考。
text.en: The Berkeley Division of the Academic Senate requests faculty include AI expectations in syllabi, though policies vary by course. Campus tested Turnitin and Rumi without full standardization; faculty discretion applies, with sample statements available via the AI Hub.

text.zh: “如果AI以当前速度改进，几年内就没有人类数学家能做AI做不了更好的事。”
text.en: “If AI continues to improve at present rate, then in a few years there’ll be nothing human mathematicians can do that AI can’t do better.”

text.zh: Borcherds指出学术系统存在明显“惯性”，可能在未来几年保持现状。他类比纸质期刊和传统技术，虽有技术突破却仍被取代，但数学领域是首次出现此类情况。
text.en: Borcherds described “plenty of inertia” in academia and compared journals to obsolete technologies like hand-weaving or horses. He noted this is the first such shift in mathematics.
